title: There is Nothing Wrong Here
blurb: For this psychological horror visual novel submitted to the Spooktober 2025 Visual Novel Jam, I served as lead programmer on a team of 4 writers, 3 artists, and 2 programmers. We built it using Godot and GDscript, emphasizing clean and modular code through inheritance and composition patterns. Players can experience the game at here.
